structure.unit: Forest Resources and the Department of Forestry

law.text:
To be certified as a prescribed burn manager, a person shall:
Successfully complete all components of the prescribed burn course developed by the State Forester and pass the examination developed for the course;
Successfully complete a training course comparable to that developed by the State Forester and pass the examination developed for Virginia's course; or
Demonstrate relevant past experience, complete a review course and pass the examination developed for Virginia's course.
